arxiv-2205-11723.title: Galvanic Corrosion and Electric Field in Lithium Anode Passivation Films: Effects on Self-Discharge
arxiv-2205-11723.creator: Kevin Leung, ∗ Laura C. Merrill, and Katharine L. Harrison
arxiv-2205-11723.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kevin Leung, ∗ Laura C. Merrill, and Katharine L. Harrison. Battery interfaces help govern rate capability, safety/stability, cycle life, and self-discharge, but significant gaps remain in our understanding at atomic length scales that can be exploited to improve interfacial properties. In particular, Li partially plated on copper current collectors, relevant to the anodeless, lithium metal cell which is a holy grail of high density energy battery research, has recently been reported to undergo galvanic corrosion and exhibit short shelf lives.

arxiv-2211-03129.title: Maximum size of C ≤ k C_{\leq k} -free strong digraphs with out-degree at least two
arxiv-2211-03129.creator: Bin Chen, Xinmin Hou, Email: cb03@ustc.edu.cn, xmhou@ustc.edu.cn
arxiv-2211-03129.description: Abstract Abstract : Let \mathscr{H} be a family of digraphs. A digraph D is \mathscr{H} -free if it contains no isomorphic copy of any member of \mathscr{H} . For k\geq 2 , we set C_{\leq k}=\{C_{2},C_{3},\ldots,C_{k}\} , where C_{\ell} is a directed cycle of length \ell\in\{2,3,\ldots,k\} .

arxiv-2211-04906.title: Cross-view Graph Contrastive Representation Learning on Partially Aligned Multi-view Data
arxiv-2211-04906.creator: Yiming Wang, Dongxia Chang, Zhiqiang Fu, Jie Wen, and Yao Zhao
arxiv-2211-04906.description: Abstract Multi-view representation learning has developed rapidly over the past decades and has been applied in many fields. However, most previous works assumed that each view is complete and aligned. This leads to an inevitable deterioration in their performance when encountering practical problems such as missing or unaligned views.

arxiv-2302-00051.title: Addendum to ”The A ^ \hat{A} -genus of S 1 S^{1} -manifolds with finite second homotopy group” Thanks: The first named author thanks the University of Augsburg for their continued support. Thanks: The second named author was supported by the SNSF-Project 200020E_193062 and the DFG-Priority programme
arxiv-2302-00051.creator: Manuel Amann, Anand Dessai
arxiv-2302-00051.description: Abstract Theorem 1.1 of [ 1 ] states that for any k>1 there exists a smooth simply connected closed 4k -dimensional manifold with finite \pi_{2} and non-vanishing \hat{A} -genus which admits a smooth effective S^{1} -action. The proof of this theorem was based on a general surgery lemma [ 1 , Lemma 2.1] .

arxiv-2310-02306.title: Collective Thomson scattering in magnetized electron and positron pair plasma and the application to induced Compton scattering
arxiv-2310-02306.creator: Rei Nishiura, Kunihito Ioka
arxiv-2310-02306.description: Abstract We consider collective Thomson scattering (CTS) of an incident X-mode wave (with the electric vector perpendicular to the background magnetic field) in magnetized electron and positron pair plasma. The collective effects do not exactly cancel out in contrast to the non-magnetized case.

arxiv-2403-13992.title: Maximum Likelihood Alternating Summation for Multistatic Angle-based Multitarget Localization
arxiv-2403-13992.creator: Martin Willame, Laurent Storrer, Hasan Can Yildirim, François Horlin, Jérôme Louveaux
arxiv-2403-13992.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Wi-Fi sensing have sparked interest in exploiting OFDM modulated communication signals for target detection and tracking. In this study, we address the angle-based localization of multiple targets using a multistatic OFDM radar. While the maximum likelihood approach optimally merges data from each radar pair comprised by the system, it entails a complex multi-dimensional search process.

arxiv-2502-14870.title: Why do Experts Disagree on Existential Risk and P(doom)? A Survey of AI Experts
arxiv-2502-14870.creator: Severin Field
arxiv-2502-14870.description: Abstract The development of artificial general intelligence (AGI) is likely to be one of humanity’s most consequential technological advancements. Leading AI labs and scientists have called for the global prioritization of AI safety ( noauthor_center_2023, 2023 ) citing existential risks comparable to nuclear war. However, research on catastrophic risks and AI alignment is often met with skepticism, even by experts.

arxiv-2506-23627.title: Brain Tumor Detection through Thermal Imaging and MobileNET
arxiv-2506-23627.creator: Roham Maiti Debasmita Bhoumik
arxiv-2506-23627.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Roham Maiti Debasmita Bhoumik. Brain plays a crucial role in regulating body functions and cognitive processes, with brain tumors posing significant risks to human health. Precise and prompt detection is a key factor in proper treatment and better patient outcomes. Traditional methods for detecting brain tumors, that include biopsies, MRI, and CT scans often face challenges due to their high costs and the need for specialized medical expertise.

arxiv-2509-05138.title: Continuum Landau surface states in a non-Hermitian Weyl semimetal
arxiv-2509-05138.creator: Shuxin Lin, Rimi Banerjee, Zheyu Cheng, Kohei Kawabata, Baile Zhang, Y. D. Chong
arxiv-2509-05138.description: Abstract The surface states of topological phases, which owe their existence to bulk topological band invariants, possess many features of deep physical significance. In some instances, they can be linked to a quantum anomaly: the violation of a classical symmetry by a field theory through the emergence of a non-conserved current.

arxiv-2510-18035.title: Quantum evolution of de Sitter black holes near extremality
arxiv-2510-18035.creator: Arindam Bhattacharjee, Muktajyoti Saha
arxiv-2510-18035.description: Abstract We study the evolution of charged, asymptotically de Sitter black holes close to the cold extremal branch of the phase space. We consider black hole sizes that are parametrically smaller than both their inverse temperature and the cosmological horizon.

pmc-10505025.creator: Xin Zhang, Huixian Zhang, Lan-Fang Li, Lei Feng, Qiao Liu

PurposeThe five-year update data from the KEYNOTE-407 study have unveiled noteworthy improvements in survival outcomes achieved with pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy (Pembro+Chemo) compared to placebo plus chemotherapy (Placebo+Chemo) for patients with previously untreated metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

pmc-11651510.title: The nonpathogenic role of hyponatremia in the onset of osteoporosis: A Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11651510.creator: Zhang Hongxing, Peng Jiafeng, Gao Minglei, Li Danyang, Junchen Zhu
pmc-11651510.description: The relationship between hyponatremia and osteoporosis is controversial, and it remains unclear if there is a causal link between the two. This study employed a 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis to investigate the potential causal relationship between hyponatremia and osteoporosis. The instrumental variables were derived from genome-wide association studies conducted in European populations.

pmc-11669878.title: EyeGPT for Patient Inquiries and Medical Education: Development and Validation of an Ophthalmology Large Language Model
pmc-11669878.creator: Xiaolan Chen, Ziwei Zhao, Weiyi Zhang, Pusheng Xu, Yue Wu, Mingpu Xu, Le Gao, Yinwen Li, Xianwen Shang, Danli Shi, Mingguang He, Gunther Eysenbach, Andrew Coristine, Kai Jin, Marcel Lucas Chee, William Rojas-Carabali, Amit Saxena, Rafael Scherer
pmc-11669878.description: BackgroundLarge language models (LLMs) have the potential to enhance clinical flow and improve medical education, but they encounter challenges related to specialized knowledge in ophthalmology.ObjectiveThis study aims to enhance ophthalmic knowledge by refining a general LLM into an ophthalmology-specialized assistant for patient inquiries and medical education.

pmc-11710675.title: Traumatic brain injury derived pathological tau polymorphs induce the distinct propagation pattern and neuroinflammatory response
pmc-11710675.creator: Nicha Puangmalai, Nemil Bhatt, Alice Bittar, Cynthia Jerez, Nikita Shchankin, Rakez Kayed
pmc-11710675.description: BackgroundThe misfolding and aggregation of the tau protein into neurofibrillary tangles constitute a central feature of tauopathies. Traumatic brain injury (TBI) has emerged as a potential risk factor, triggering the onset and progression of tauopathies. Our previous research revealed distinct polymorphisms in soluble tau oligomers originating from single versus repetitive mild TBIs.

pmc-12754049.title: Comparable oncological and functional outcomes of robot-assisted radical prostatectomy with conventional anterior approach and Hood technique using DAVINCI SP system
pmc-12754049.creator: Po-Hung Lin, Hung-Jen Wang, Hung-Cheng Kan, See-Tong Pang, Kai-Jie Yu, Chun-Te Wu
pmc-12754049.description: The DAVINCI SP system is an advanced robotic surgery platform allowing an endoscope and three articulated instruments to enter the body through a single incision while maintaining workspace triangulation. This open-label, single-arm clinical trial (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05403190 18/05/2022) evaluates the feasibility of using the DAVINVI SP system for extraperitoneal-approach robot-assisted radical prostatectomy (RaRP) in Taiwan.

pmc-13216287.title: Analysis and research on iron loss of multi-layer interior permanent magnet synchronous motor for electric vehicle applications
pmc-13216287.creator: Lianbo Niu
pmc-13216287.description: Iron loss of stator is one of the main losses of interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM). Therefore, effectively reducing iron loss is of great significance for improving operating efficiency. The air gap flux density is analyzed under various operating conditions, and three models for calculating iron loss are analyzed and compared.

pmc-13323554.title: Management of acute myasthenic crisis in developing countries
pmc-13323554.creator: Serigne Abdou Aziz Fall, Hélène Bassama, Mamadou Diawo Bah, Mamadou Ka, Adjaratou Dieynabou Sow, Ndiaga Matar Gaye, Moustapha Ndiaye
pmc-13323554.description: rized by worsening MG symptoms, which may be associated with respiratory involvement, bulbar dysfunction, or tetraparesis. A myasthenic crisis is defined as respiratory failure requiring intubation due to MG-related muscle weakness. While international guidelines recommend intravenous immunoglobulins or plasma exchange as first-line therapies, these options are unavailable in many low-resource countries.

pmc-13616892.title: Drivers of Mosquito Microbiome Composition: Effects of Species, Locality, Season, and Plasmodium Infection
pmc-13616892.creator: Marta Garrigós, Jesús Veiga, Mario Garrido, María José García-López, Manuel Morales-Yuste, Clotilde Marín, Jesús Recuero, María José Rosales, Isabel Moreno-Indias, Josué Martínez-de la Puente
pmc-13616892.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mosquito microbiota influences mosquito physiology and pathogen development, finally affecting their vectorial capacity. Identifying the factors that affect the composition of mosquito microbial communities in nature is essential for designing effective strategies to control vector-borne pathogens. Here, we used a 16 S rRNA metabarcoding approach to analyse the microbiome of 196 mosquito pools (four females per pool) of three common species: Culex pipiens, Aedes albopictus, and Culiseta longiareolata.
